# Deposits

Useful stone where the rocks and rivers put it (A5.7 step 9, `WLD-14`): each lies in a rock, in river beds, or both, with a richness from 1 to 5, and a river may carry it downstream, its share falling as it goes.
What each yields joins when stones become things (α08).

## Flint in chalk

Nodules of flint in bands between the chalk's beds: the stone that flakes, found where the chalk is cut, in cliffs, pits and stream banks.

<!-- table: generated by `kd catalog tables`; edit the block, not the table -->
| | |
|---|---|
| Lies in | chalk |
| Richness | 1 to 5 of 5 |
| Carried | no |
<!-- end table -->

```toml
id = "flint_in_chalk"
name = "Flint in chalk"
stage = "MIL-01"
checks = ["WLD-14"]
rock = "chalk"
rivers = false
richness = [1, 5]
```

## River gravel

Cobbles of every rock upstream in a river's bed and bars, flint among them below the chalk; the farther from where the river cut the chalk, the fewer flints, as they break and wear: their share falls by 0.8 every 10 km.

<!-- table: generated by `kd catalog tables`; edit the block, not the table -->
| | |
|---|---|
| Lies in | river cells |
| Richness | 1 to 3 of 5 |
| Carried | downstream, keeping 0.8 of its share every 10 km |
<!-- end table -->

```toml
id = "river_gravel"
name = "River gravel"
stage = "MIL-01"
checks = ["WLD-14"]
rivers = true
richness = [1, 3]
carried = { keep = 0.8, every = "10 km" }
```
